name: guestvine
title: GuestVine
description: Find every podcast someone has been a guest on, and get their new appearances in your podcast app.
author: guestvine

commands.name: search-guests
commands.title: Search Podcast Guests
commands.description: Search for a person and list the podcast episodes they recently appeared on as a guest.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
